video.decoding_capability: IP: 8MP: 60 fps in total (2 CH max.); 4MP: 120 fps in total (4 CH max.); 1080P: 240 fps in total (8 CH max.)
outputs: 1 x HDMI (up to 3840 x 2160, 4K at 30 Hz)

power.supply: Input: AC 100 ~ 240V, 50 ~ 60 Hz; Output: DC 12 V, 3.0 A

features: Analog main stream 8 MP-Lite at 8 fps for each channel
Audio over coaxial: 16 CHs, one-way (TVI cameras only)
Ultra Motion Detection for analog cameras: max. 16 CHs
notes: Datasheet lists 16 analog and 8 IP channels, up to 24 channels in total; with IP cameras only, up to 24 IP channels.
Input bandwidth is 80 Mbps, rising to 112 Mbps once all analog channels are converted to IP; incoming_mbps gives the 112 Mbps figure.
Audio over RCA is one channel, one-way, for channel 1 only.
Power consumption is stated excluding HDD.
